title: Core Validation 009B-2 — Persistent Effect Geometry
decision_question: After carrier causal sufficiency is established, do the 64-dimensional carrier effect vectors a_i = Ghat_i r admit a compact reusable shared linear coordinate system whose online incremental span grows slowly and generalizes to heldout effects?

scope.reason: 009B-2 tests the reusable effect representation prerequisite only. Sparse coefficients and deployable routing are forbidden until low-dimensional reuse is confirmed.

data.selection_and_partition: exact Core 006/007/009A/009B-1 pinned sequence selection; router examples may participate in projection preparation/extraction batching but never in 009B-2 train/eval statistics

effect_definition.write: G_i = mean_t[(U^T dL/dh_t) z_t^T] on the frozen foundation path
effect_definition.carrier: r = normalized mean of train-token projected activations z, fitted independently per seed using train only
effect_definition.subspace_origin: linear through the origin; no heldout centering, affine offset, labels or target metadata may enter V

offline_geometry.fit: uncentered train-effect covariance C = mean_i[a_i a_i^T]; V_d is the top-d eigenspace

online_growth.algorithm: Start V empty. For each training effect in the frozen stream order, compute residual e=(I-VV^T)a. If ||e||/||a|| > tau, append normalized e after double re-orthogonalization. Never rotate or refit existing coordinates.
online_growth.sha_order: sort train effects by SHA256(seed:ordering_name:token_sha256); canonical preserves repository sequence order
online_growth.late_window: final half of the training stream
metrics: heldout median/p90 effect residual of final online basis
online_growth.independent_memory_baseline: one effect vector per write, K_independent=N

discovery.selection_rule: Choose the smallest compact candidate dimension d that independently on both discovery seeds has eval median residual <=0.25, eval p90 residual <=0.50 and train-to-eval median residual gap <=0.10. Dimensions above 32 are diagnostic only and can never unlock confirmation.

replication.formal_hardware: Kaggle GPU for frozen hidden/gradient extraction; all effect-space geometry and online growth are CPU-safe after extraction

stop_rule.discovery_failure: Do not open confirmation. A compact <=32-dimensional shared effect space was not found under the frozen residual criterion.
stop_rule.confirmation_failure: Stop the persistent-effect dictionary route. Do not run 009B-3 deployable addressability unless a new effect representation hypothesis is frozen.
stop_rule.confirmation_success: Proceed to Core 009B-3 Deployable Effect Addressability. Do not add certificates or continual mutation yet.

interpretation_boundary: A positive result supports compact/reusable effect geometry for this frozen-Pythia regime. It does not establish sparse coefficients, deployable routing, safe continual mutation, bounded long-horizon growth across models, or an end-to-end CLM.
A 64-dimensional ambient cap is not evidence of bounded growth. Confirmation requires compact <=32-dimensional representation plus late-growth and heldout-residual gates.
Online growth uses multiple frozen orderings so a lucky stream order cannot by itself create a positive result.
Effect vectors retain their natural carrier magnitude from Ghat r. They are not individually renormalized before fitting or growth.
All shared coordinates are learned from train effects only; eval effects never influence V or the growth stream.
